'''Fruit Salad''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

'''Note:''' This recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients.

==Bundles==
Fruit Salad is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Fruit Salad is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Fruit Salad is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create a [[Tailoring|Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt072.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Fruit Salad is not used in any [[Quests|quests]].

==Trivia==
* Despite the description calling it a combination of summer fruit, [[Apricot Tree]]s only produce Apricots in the spring.
* Fruit salad restores the highest amount of both [[energy]] and [[health]] of any cooked dish in the game.
